title: Status Only Flips On Success
description: Map out every outcome the mock gateway can hand back and confirm the invoice's own status column only ever moves to "paid" for the one outcome that actually earns it.
successCondition: Against three separate freshly-created invoices, pay one with the decline card, one with the timeout card, and one with a normal succeeding card. GET /api/billing/invoices/:id for all three afterward shows: decline -> still "open", timeout -> still "open", succeeded -> "paid". Querying the invoices table via `npm run db:psql` for all three ids in one query confirms the status column matches exactly this pattern — not just the two "stays open" cases, which are easy to conflate with each other.
hints: Only the succeeded branch of apps/api/src/modules/billing/service.ts's pay() flow calls prisma.invoice.update to set status: "paid" — the declined and timed_out branches update the Payment row only.
You need three separate invoices (three separate shipments) since an already-open invoice can be paid again after a decline, but you want to isolate each outcome cleanly here.
